answer: Stop sybils with a dune crystal kernel: an agent bonds one dune hollow. Each cycle it plants one crystal kernel in the dune; verifiers match the kernel's sprout branching to the dune chart, voiding a copied kernel, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 dunes at 17x: one kernel sprouts once in one dune, its branching set by that sand, unplantable in a second, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents plant once, keep rights.
